title: Spatial Prediction with Guided Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.12967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial prediction is a critically important task in data analyses that involve spatially or spatio-temporally-referenced data. It is commonly carried out using hierarchical models, which comprise a process model describing the latent process of interest, and a data model describing how the process is observed. The target quantity is the predictive distribution, which is the conditional distribution of the latent spatial process given the observed data. Unfortunately, the predictive distribution is rarely available in closed form and can be difficult to sample from. Here, we show how recent developments in guided diffusion modelling from machine learning can address a wide class of problems in spatial prediction when the likelihood function derived from the data model is known and differentiable, possibly after relaxation. translated_title: 基于引导扩散的空间预测
translated_abstract: 空间预测是涉及空间或时空参考数据的分析中一项至关重要的任务。它通常通过分层模型来实现，该模型由两部分组成：描述感兴趣的潜在过程的过程模型，以及描述该过程如何被观测的数据模型。目标量是预测分布，即在给定观测数据条件下潜在空间过程的条件分布。遗憾的是，预测分布很少能以封闭形式获得，且往往难以从中采样。本文展示了机器学习中引导扩散建模的最新进展，如何解决当由数据模型导出的似然函数已知且可微（可能经过松弛处理）时的一大类空间预测问题。为展示该方法的多功能性，我们将其应用于高斯与非高斯过程模型以及多种……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用机器学习中的引导扩散模型，在似然函数已知且可微的条件下求解一大类空间预测问题，并可灵活应用于高斯与非高斯过程模型。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that guided diffusion models from machine learning can solve a wide class of spatial prediction problems when the likelihood function is known and differentiable, and the approach is applicable to both Gaussian and non-Gaussian process models.
